core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hammam is an Arabic-origin name meaning “A bathhouse, a public bath”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hammam corresponds to the Arabic form حمام (Arabic root ح م م (ḥ-m-m); حَمَّام (Ḥammām)). Its core sense is bathhouse, public bath. Hammam is Arabic حَمَّام (Ḥammām) 'a bathhouse, a public bath', from the root ح م م (ḥ-m-m). It is also used as a personal name (for example the early Islamic scholar Hammām ibn Munabbih). The source gloss 'bathhouse' is correct. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily a common noun and its use as a given name is less frequent.
